title: sutra_cochange: git pretty-format error 'invalid --pretty format: COMMIT_SEP'
description:
`sutra_cochange` returns:
```
MCP error -32603: internal: git log: fatal: invalid --pretty format: COMMIT_SEP
```

**Reproduce:** call `sutra_cochange(workspace="chitta", path="src/tools/search.rs")` against `/home/josh/soft/manas/chitta`.

**Likely cause:** an unquoted format-string literal in the git command construction. Looks like the code intends `--pretty=format:%H%nCOMMIT_SEP%n...` but is passing `--pretty=COMMIT_SEP` or similar — the `format:` prefix is missing or the literal is being shell-escaped wrong. Trivial fix once located in the cochange shellout code.

**Surfaced during:** chitta release-review spike, 2026-05-08. Cochange data would have informed deepening recommendations (paired files that should be one module) but the pack had to omit it.

acceptance_criteria.text: sutra_cochange against chitta/src/tools/search.rs returns valid co-change list, not an internal error
Add a regression test pinning the git pretty-format string
Verify against at least one other workspace (sutra, smriti) to confirm not a chitta-specific git config issue
